author: Scott Horsley
title: Waffle House drops egg surcharge as prices fall back to Earth
description: Waffle House has dropped its 50 cent surcharge on eggs as supplies rebound.  The chain added the temporary charge in February, when avian flu sent egg prices to record highs.
content:
In a welcome sign that sky-high egg prices are coming home to roost, Waffle House is dropping its 50 cent per egg surcharge. 
"Egg-cellent news," the chain announced Tuesday in a social media post. … [+1533 chars]
